entries.title: Man killed in Englewood shooting
entries.summary: <p>A man was shot to death on Saturday afternoon in Englewood on the South Side. </p><p>The man, 35, was standing on the sidewalk in the 5600 block of South Racine Avenue when someone approached him and fired shots around 4:50 p.m, Chicago police said. </p><p>The man suffered multiple gunshot wounds and was taken to the University of Chicago Medical Center, where he died, police said. His name hasn't been released. </p><p>No arrests were made. </p><p>Area 1 detectives are investigating.</p>
entries.author: Sun-Times Wire

entries.title: Man fatally shot during fight in Little Village
entries.summary: <p>A man was shot to death after a fight broke out Saturday afternoon in Little Village on the Southwest Side. </p><p>The man, 40, was on the sidewalk in the 2800 block of South Saint Louis Avenue when he got into a fight with someone around 2:30 p.m., Chicago police said. The person he got into a fight with pulled a gun and shot the man multiple times.</p><p>The 40-year-old was taken to Mount Sinai Hospital, where he was pronounced dead, police said. His name hasn't been released. </p><p>No arrests were made. </p>
